strongest_comparator: The previous exact even-mass representation retains a positive-cut linear cusp but supplies no two-point boundary estimate. The limiting geodesic-seam comparison cannot directly be applied to that cusp.
hardest_step: Separate the reflected mass from a smooth continuation, keep its odd linear and cubic tags through the full resolvent identity, and control the resulting corner finite part and its contact on H2 shapes without a pointwise second-derivative trace.
new_consequence: The actual reflected-boundary correction relative to the specified smooth-continuation representative has an ordinary moving-cut limit after the full constant row is allocated. Its corner contacts vanish with the first-derivative trace; this contribution cannot supply a persistent oscillation.
remaining_quantum_gap: The smooth-continuation representative is not yet identified with the normal model. Density factors, the smooth local comparison, fixed derivative contacts and all local shape partners remain to be combined.
regulator_contract: Original paired domain, Euclidean period, mass chart, angular tower and common subtraction. The smooth continuation is a comparison representative, not a new physical state or boundary prescription. The actual cusp and finite corner contact are retained.
verification_scope: Bessel and Born envelopes, tagged convolution integrals, logarithmic corner finite parts against independent direct subtraction, ordinary cut convergence and concentrated H2 remainder tests. No full charged two-point kernel evaluation or formal continuum certification is claimed.
initial_diagnostic_failure: The first frozen run raised a complex-ordering exception in tagged-convolution quadrature after 35 passed checks. Reproduction showed endpoint cosine values slightly below zero at finite precision. The exact substitution cos(theta)=1-w^2 keeps the incomplete-gamma arguments positive and removes the endpoint singularity. Preserve the original run and sources; do not project complex results or change tolerances.
